Photorealistic documentary realism, original AI-generated artistic interpretation, not a photograph. Scene: La Concha Bay, Donostia / San Sebastian from the public Alderdi Eder end of Paseo de La Concha, plausible eye-level camera looking west-southwest across the real bay. Geometry and anchors: the famous white ornamental La Concha railing in the immediate lower foreground; the broad crescent of pale sand and promenade curving away along the left-to-center shore; calm bay water; Santa Clara Island centered in the bay mouth; Monte Igeldo forming the right/west headland; restrained Belle Epoque waterfront buildings along the curve, without turning them into a continuous fantasy facade. Include only a few small non-identifiable walkers. Keep the island, headland and complete bay readable, centered enough for a later vertical 4:5 crop. Actual scenario: 23 September 2026 at 20:31 Europe/Madrid, DUSK twilight, 28 minutes after local sunset 20:03; approximate sun elevation -5.55 degrees and azimuth 275.47 west. Open-Meteo model: 22.1 C, overcast code 3, 98 percent cloud, no precipitation, very light wind; model data, not an on-site observation. Render an overcast blue-grey twilight, low cloud ceiling, subdued sea reflections and perhaps only a very faint lighter western band. Surfaces are dry. Do not invent rain, wet pavement, stars, moon, dramatic sunset, boats unless tiny and non-focal, event lighting, logos, legible signs, or text. No aerial view, no fisheye, no cinematic teal-orange grade, no HDR. Tripod-stable 35mm-equivalent perspective, neutral natural color, authentic railing and shoreline proportions. No captions or watermark.
